LOCALIZATION AND ALLOCATION | G2-G6 | 2018-2026
|
|-- Expand: translated admin and market development
|   |-- [S] 2018: translated UI improved lead conversion; no amount.
|   |-- [S] 2019: admin in 20 languages; marketing/partners expanded.
|   |-- [S] Outside-core merchant share: 24% 2018 -> 29% 2019.
|   `-- [S] Core = North America + UK + Australia in the 2018 account.
|       [I] Do not splice this into the later outside-NA series.
|
|-- Product + acquisition investment -[assoc]-> international growth
|   |-- [S] International merchant growth existed before admin translation.
|   |-- [S] Management attributes gains to localization and go-to-market.
|   `-- [I] Bundled changes prevent isolating translation's contribution.
|
|-- Reckoning to reacceleration: broaden local capabilities
|   |-- [S] 2022: localized plan pricing in ~200 countries; local billing.
|   |-- [S] Q3 2026: WhatsApp sign-in, marketing and messaging launched.
|   |-- [S] Q3 2026: localized Shop app launched in Japan.
|   `-- [S] Q3 2026: local-currency billing added in 10 countries.
|
|-- Allocation: long horizon, limited spend visibility
|   |-- [S] 2018: international primary investment; multi-year payoff expected.
|   |-- [S] 2025: ~40% of marketing targeted markets outside NA.
|   |-- [S] Capital: four countries in 2022 -> eight entering 2026.
|   `-- [I] Marketing share is not total international investment share.
|
`-- Merchant growth -[untestable]-> regional investment return
    [I] Excerpts lack regional spend, margins and comparable cohort returns.
